newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-BZW RAISES GKN ESTIMATES.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-BZW RAISES GKN ESTIMATES.

text.p: BZW raised its earnings forecasts for GKN Plc on Thursday after the UK engineering group yesterday posted a 12.2 percent jump in its interim profits, dealers said.
The brokerage raised its 1997 and 1998 pre-tax profit estimates to 400 million stg from 385 million stg and to 440 million stg from 415 million stg, they said.
While currency constraints have dogged the stock's performance since late 1996, BZW said it expected growth to be bolstered by improved margins in aerospace going forward.
At 0942 GMT, the stock was down 3-1/2p at 1152-1/2, after jumping 70p, or 6.5 percent, yesterday.
